svg.font-family: Poppins, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: The competitive frame, written as three lines
svg.desc: Three lines make a position: instead of what, naming the real alternative including doing nothing; better on which single axis, only one; and worse on what, naming the trade you are asking a customer to accept. The third line is the one that does the work.
svg.text: POSITIONING IS COMPARATIVE, OR IT IS NOTHING
Name the real alternative, including doing nothing and the incumbent they already use.
One. Claim three and you have claimed none, because the reader keeps the one they believed.
Name the trade you are asking a customer to accept, or you have written a wish.
The third line is the one clients argue about, and the one that does the work.
